cards.desc:
**A Stand is a visual manifestation of life energy, unique to the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series.**

**A Stand is an entity physically generated by its owner, referred to as a Stand User. It generally presents itself as a figure hovering over or near the user and possesses abilities beyond that of an ordinary human, which, depending on the Stand User, can be wielded for good or evil.**

**The Stand is created from someone's psyche, which includes not only humans but also other living creatures. That individual is referred to as the Stand User. The User then gives their Stand a name and uses it for various purposes.**

**One of the general rules of stand users is that a stand can interact with a non-stand user. However, in most cases a normal user can NOT interact with a stand. Another rule is that no one can have more than one stand at a time.**
cards.name: What are Stands?

cards.desc:
**The Ripple (or Hamon) is energy identical to the Sun's rays, which the human body can produce through controlled breathing, having the effect of producing ripples of energy propagating from the bloodstream to the rest of the body and other objects in contact with it. The Ripple manifests itself as electricity-like sparks, and it can be seen by ordinary humans.**
**Ripple can also affect non-living things. An object charged with Ripple energy will have one or several attributes enhanced by the energy, making it a more effective tool, or weapon. Liquids conduct the Ripple especially well,It is mentioned by Joseph Joestar that objects covered in oil can conduct Ripple much easier. However while all materials can conduct the Ripple more or less well, an inorganic material such as metal cannot store the energy, which simply passes through.**

**Hamon is mainly used to defeat vampires as it is used to channel sunlight into a punch through a vampire's body.**
cards.name: What is Hamon?

cards.desc:
**Vampires were created by the Pillar Men with acupuncture techniques that they developed through the use of the Stone Mask, which was created by Kars.**

**Vampires are known for their numerous superhuman traits. The most obvious abilities are their raw strength, regeneration, blood-sucking tentacles at their fingers and near-immortality. On top of that, many vampires are capable of manipulating their bodies in creative and unique ways.**
**It is to note that hamon is the most effective against vampires because it is channeling sunlight into their opponent. Meaning in-game vampires take more damage from hamon charged attacked.**
cards.name: What is Vampirism?

‌

## 200 Balloons: Inflate's Slam variant creates 1 more balloon per 30 invested ability points, up to 5 extra. Total Balloons' EX meter drain is reduced by up to 1/3rd with ability investment

## Beyond The Sea: Jellyfish Summon and Humu Summon lifespan scales

## Cat Size: Ankle Snare's lifetime and trap duration scale with ability, up to 50% longer.

## Catch The Rainbow: Motionless Rain creates 1 additional drop per arm for every 50 ability points invested.

## Emperor: Hol Horse Philosophy time limit and Blind Shot bullet lifespan scale with ability, up to 50% longer. Emperor Pulemet's movement penalty scales with ability, removing up to 35% of the movement penalty.

## Glory Days: Mag size scales with ability, increasing by 1 for every 30 points.

## Harvest: Search Party's scouting interval scales and maximum finds scale with ability, up to 50% faster intervals and +3 max finds. All harvest poison damage scales with ability, dealing up to 50% more per tick.

## Heaven's Door: Written Command's special effects from "Forget Motion" "Forget Me" and "Lower Your Guard" have their duration scale with ability, up to 50% longer. Safety Lock scales with ability, preventing up to 3 additional attacks.

## Hermit Purple: Hermit's Sling search and travel range scales with ability, up to 50% further.

## John Rod: Blind the Heavens' charge speed scales with ability, charging up to 33% faster

## Magician's Red: Crossfire Hurricane's projectile range scales with ability, up to 50% further. With Life Detector, the homing detection range, homing duration, and homing turn speed scale with ability, up to 50% longer/faster. Life Detector's radius and lifespan scales with ability, up to 50% larger radius/longer lifespan.

## Rolling Stones: Super Glue's healing and duration scale with ability, up to 50%. Rolling Stones begins moving sooner scaling with ability, up to 33% sooner. Rolling Stones' "Within Death's Reach" triggers earlier scaling with ability, from 10 seconds to a max of 15 seconds.

## Smoke On The Water: Boil duration and Pressure Cooker duration scales off ability, up to 50% longer. Puddle size from Super Soaker and Hot Potato scales off ability, up to 50% wider/deeper puddles. Heat self damage scales off ability, up to 1/3rd less self damage.

## Smooth Operators: All special effects from the EX moves have their duration scale with ability, up to 50% longer.

## Super Fly: Damage Redirection's max damage stored scales with ability, from 120 up to a max of 180.

## The Grateful Dead: Withering Mist range and aging stacks per tick scales with ability, up to 50% larger range and stacks applied per tick. Senior Citizen EX meter gain and age stacks scale off ability, up to 50% more meter gain and 33% less aging stacks. Ice Pack duration and unclaimed ice lifespan scale off ability, up to 50% longer.

## The Sun: The Sun's model size scales with ability, capped at twice its normal size.

## Tower of Gray: Acid Spit fires an additional glob per 30 points in ability, up to 5 extra.

## Tubular Bells: Inflate Balloons' balloon slots increase by 1 per 30 points in ability. Pick Up Scent duration, Balloon Flower duration, and Balloon Parade duration scale off ability, up to 50%

## Under World: Burrow and Unearth's Warrior lifespan scale with ability, up to 50% longer. Unearth and Prop Memory's wind ups shorten by up to 1/3rd. Every 30 ability points invested adds an additional Tora side bomb to Tora! Tora! Tora!

## Walking Heart: Highest Heels duration scales with ability, from 10 seconds up to a max of 15 seconds. Heel length and other moves remain their fixed values.

## West End Girl: Money Case lifespan and Gap Traverse range scale with ability, up to 50% longer.

## Lore:

**Yuya Fungami’s Stand tracks people by scent. It can split into a pack of feet to chase its target and drain their nutrients to heal its user.**

---

![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6adbbc892110803ccd561a60/attachments/6adfcc9c82f8976dee14ce4f/previews/6adfcc9c82f8976dee14ce72/download/image.webp)

## Pose:

![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6adbbc892110803ccd561a60/attachments/6adfccb374f6012e0f46e2c4/previews/6adfccb674f6012e0f46e597/download/image.webp)

---

## Scent

**Scented enemies appear on your scent list and are marked through walls. Pursuit can chase them within 600 studs. Becoming Soaked washes the scent off.**

![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6adbbc892110803ccd561a60/attachments/6adfcdc2edeb46d984115c86/previews/6adfcdc2edeb46d984115d17/download/image.webp)

## Barrage

**Unleash a rapid flurry of punches on your opponent.**

**Base cooldown: 14s**

![barrages.gif](https://trello.com/1/cards/6adbbc892110803ccd561a60/attachments/6adfce55a7a43b5540855c8d/previews/6adfce5aa7a43b5540856035/download/barrages.gif)

## Scent Trap

**Aim at a throwable to coat it in scent, or aim at the ground to throw a fake Mysterious Arrow. Touching either applies Scented for 3 minutes. The arrow also drains and slows whoever takes the bait. Traps last 1 minute, with up to one arrow and two coated items at a time.**

**Base cooldown: 30s**

## Arrow:

![arrow.gif](https://trello.com/1/cards/6adbbc892110803ccd561a60/attachments/6adfcec23a2fa5a890628ced/previews/6adfcec43a2fa5a8906292a8/download/arrow.gif)

## Object:

![trap.gif](https://trello.com/1/cards/6adbbc892110803ccd561a60/attachments/6adfcef58a32b97d9c78533a/previews/6adfcef78a32b97d9c7854b1/download/trap.gif)

## Pursuit

**Tap to send Highway Star after your selected Scented target within 600 studs. It chases them on its own and drains them on contact, healing you and filling your Nutrients. Hold to recall it, or hold while it is home to cycle through scents. A perfect block as the feet land is the only way to turn them away. Sent from a pilot, it lets you go for the hunt and stays out as the pack when it is done.**

**Base cooldown: 28s**

![feet.gif](https://trello.com/1/cards/6adbbc892110803ccd561a60/attachments/6adfcfe6f1899879f187ac87/previews/6adfcfeef1899879f187ba5a/download/feet.gif)

## Recall: (HOLD)

![recall.gif](https://trello.com/1/cards/6adbbc892110803ccd561a60/attachments/6adfd01b73b0a4ee7db6c582/previews/6adfd02173b0a4ee7db6d164/download/recall.gif)

## Footprints

**A perfect block as Pursuit’s feet land turns them away; once they are on, only becoming Soaked or riding in a fast-moving vehicle removes them, and the same goes for the feet left by Footprint Storm.**

## Nutrient Siphon

**Highway Star grabs an enemy in front of it and drains their health to heal you. Scented enemies are held longer and gain more Withered stacks. Against a downed enemy, finish them off and recover 30% of your maximum health.**

**Base cooldown: 18s**

![siphon.gif](https://trello.com/1/cards/6adbbc892110803ccd561a60/attachments/6adfd0eff865ada38c0d444d/previews/6adfd0f7f865ada38c0d4fe1/download/siphon.gif)

## Nutrients

**Stand attacks and draining enemies fill your Nutrients, up to 100. Stored Nutrients gradually heal you while Highway Star is summoned. Below 60, you take 20% more damage and move 15% slower while it is out. At 100, your next Scent Trap or Nutrient Siphon is stronger and leaves you with 60. Nutrients start fading after 6 seconds without feeding.**

![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6adbbc892110803ccd561a60/attachments/6adfd0a7fbf87502d4fa37c5/previews/6adfd0a7fbf87502d4fa3897/download/image.webp)

## Foot Form

**Hold the summon key to split Highway Star into a pack of feet. While piloting, move 75% faster and climb walls by moving into them. You cannot punch or fly in this form. Hold the key again to change back.**

**Base cooldown: 3s**

![feets.gif](https://trello.com/1/cards/6adbbc892110803ccd561a60/attachments/6adfd1b7d493ccb0cc64b483/previews/6adfd1b9d493ccb0cc64b5df/download/feets.gif)

## Climbing:

![climb.gif](https://trello.com/1/cards/6adbbc892110803ccd561a60/attachments/6adfd296c47a78ab219eb459/previews/6adfd29ac47a78ab219ebc18/download/climb.gif)

## Footprint Flurry

**In Foot Form, strike enemies in front of you with a flurry of feet. Hits apply Scented and occasionally drain health to heal you. The final hit knocks them back. in normal form, use Barrage instead.**

**Base cooldown: 14s**

![flurry.gif](https://trello.com/1/cards/6adbbc892110803ccd561a60/attachments/6adfd2ec170f307fe2c52a33/previews/6adfd2ef170f307fe2c530e1/download/flurry.gif)

---

## EX Moveset

## I’m so Handsome (2 Bars)

**Pose with Highway Star to recover 25% of your maximum health and gain 40 Nutrients. Getting hit before the pose finishes cancels both rewards.**

**Base cooldown: 70s**

![pooose.gif](https://trello.com/1/cards/6adbbc892110803ccd561a60/attachments/6adfd3e9a0f84eaf698397be/previews/6adfd3eda0f84eaf69839b72/download/pooose.gif)

## DEEEEP SNIFF (3 Bars)

**Take a deep breath to detect enemies within 1,000 studs and apply Scented for 6 minutes. Can only be used out of combat.**

**Base cooldown: 120s**

![sniff.gif](https://trello.com/1/cards/6adbbc892110803ccd561a60/attachments/6adfd480a8f777ec6d1b4144/previews/6adfd486a8f777ec6d1b504e/download/sniff.gif)

## Footprint Storm (3 Bars)

**Sweep a wave of feet in front of you. Enemies caught in it are stuck repeatedly, drained and thrown back. Scented enemies take more hits. They can dash out before the feet close in. After the attack, some feet remain attached for 4 seconds, draining and slowing them.**

**Base cooldown: 40s**

![storm.gif](https://trello.com/1/cards/6adbbc892110803ccd561a60/attachments/6adfd525f51d514789675ca8/previews/6adfd536f51d5147896778a7/download/storm.gif)

**Aya Tsuji runs Morioh’s Cinderella salon, where she uses her Stand to change people’s faces and bodies. ## Lore:

## “Got him! He took the bait!”

**The stand of Pesci, a member of La Squadra Esecuzioni. Beach Boy is a fishing rod whose line and hook pass through anything but their prey. Any attack on the line travels into whoever is hooked.**

---

## Pose:

![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6ad1d959c077dd6581a2e4ac/attachments/6ad1db91f849b0f8d791ea2f/previews/6ad1db91f849b0f8d791eb21/download/image.webp)

![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6ad1d959c077dd6581a2e4ac/attachments/6ad1db82fe0536551935ff73/previews/6ad1db83fe05365519360157/download/image.webp)

---

## Ability Scaling

**Ability makes your line longer and your reel stronger. The line can reach up to 225 studs.**

## For My Bro!

**Anyone who kills a member of your party is marked for 20 seconds. Your hook sinks into them 50% faster.**

## Cast Out (Ctrl)

**Steer your hook through walls and floors to catch someone. Use again to stop steering, then again to resume. Heavy attacks reels it back.**

**Base cooldown: 1s**

![reel.gif](https://trello.com/1/cards/6ad1d959c077dd6581a2e4ac/attachments/6ad1ef9c47abef2f2d048c74/previews/6ad1efa247abef2f2d049d3e/download/reel.gif)

## The Line Carries

**You and your allies can hit the line to damage whoever is hooked. Hamon also travels through it.**

## An Angler’s Hold

**Being ragdolled or hit with heavy knockback releases whoever you have hooked, including during Focused Fishing.**

## Big Catches

**Hook a large object, such as a car. Hold M1 to reel yourself toward it, or press R for a quick pull.**

## Quick Pull (R)

![rpull.gif](https://trello.com/1/cards/6ad1d959c077dd6581a2e4ac/attachments/6ad1f53a4d57f8689e1f01dd/previews/6ad1f5404d57f8689e1f0a0d/download/rpull.gif)

## Reel (M1)

![m1reel.gif](https://trello.com/1/cards/6ad1d959c077dd6581a2e4ac/attachments/6ad1f5581f199751fbd54833/previews/6ad1f5641f199751fbd55563/download/m1reel.gif)

## Good Vibrations

**While steering the hook inside a wall or underground, nearby people appear as pink squares and loose objects appear as pale squares.**

![vibrations.gif](https://trello.com/1/cards/6ad1d959c077dd6581a2e4ac/attachments/6ad1f0104a4a6839ffcfeda9/previews/6ad1f0154a4a6839ffcff51f/download/vibrations.gif)

## Objects:

![object.gif](https://trello.com/1/cards/6ad1d959c077dd6581a2e4ac/attachments/6ad1f056ac99153620c9109e/previews/6ad1f05aac99153620c91526/download/object.gif)

## Quickcast

**Cast your hook toward your aim in a shallow arc. It catches people, sticks into large objects, or stays where it lands.**

**Base cooldown: 6s**

![quickcast.gif](https://trello.com/1/cards/6ad1d959c077dd6581a2e4ac/attachments/6ad1f0a192c39419dccb81e2/previews/6ad1f0a592c39419dccb83f3/download/quickcast.gif)

## Hook Depth

**Hold M1 to reel someone in and build depth. More Strength makes the hook sink faster. Deeper hooks slow them more and deal more damage when pulled out. At 25% depth or more, R tears the hook out. They escape if they get too far beyond your line's reach.**

![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6ad1d959c077dd6581a2e4ac/attachments/6ad1f19137b04a8b3e4ced2f/previews/6ad1f19237b04a8b3e4cee24/download/image.webp)

## M1 Reel:

![reels.gif](https://trello.com/1/cards/6ad1d959c077dd6581a2e4ac/attachments/6ad1f23ed23feb3a2c3987b1/previews/6ad1f24bd23feb3a2c399764/download/reels.gif)

## R Tear: (With Depth)

![tear.gif](https://trello.com/1/cards/6ad1d959c077dd6581a2e4ac/attachments/6ad1f2589d74a9e659d3c939/previews/6ad1f25c9d74a9e659d3d1c2/download/tear.gif)

## Double Snag

**Whip the hook twice. Landing both hits causes bleeding. If someone is already hooked, tear it out and try to hook them again at half depth.**

**Base cooldown: 12s**

![doublesnag.gif](https://trello.com/1/cards/6ad1d959c077dd6581a2e4ac/attachments/6ad1f314b4b2369ed1dbf263/previews/6ad1f317b4b2369ed1dbf432/download/doublesnag.gif)

## If hooked:

![half.gif](https://trello.com/1/cards/6ad1d959c077dd6581a2e4ac/attachments/6ad1f382f6909aef29de5194/previews/6ad1f385f6909aef29de553a/download/half.gif)

**(Tearing heart out and proccing bleed, then re-entering with half the depth: 77% to 39%.)**

## Set the Hook

**Drive the hook deeper (25%) and fling your catch. Move sideways to throw them left or right. Otherwise, pull them back. Can smash them into breakable walls.**

**Base cooldown: 16s**

![SNAG.gif](https://trello.com/1/cards/6ad1d959c077dd6581a2e4ac/attachments/6ad1f66f1ae42dac2c02df6f/previews/6ad1f6711ae42dac2c02e2ed/download/SNAG.gif)

## Smashing them into a wall

![directionsnag.gif](https://trello.com/1/cards/6ad1d959c077dd6581a2e4ac/attachments/6ad1f6922b297678c3dbd2cf/previews/6ad1f6942b297678c3dbd4eb/download/directionsnag.gif)

**(Holding A to fling the enemy to the left side.)**

## Krafted

**Kraft Work’s heavy attacks, hits from projectiles you froze, Fixation and Kinetic Field leave enemies Krafted for 10 seconds. Contact Fixation and touching your frozen objects also mark enemies. A heavy attack that releases a Kinetized enemy does not add a new mark or refresh one. Hold Werk to turn nearby enemies with your mark Kineticized, or use Tapping with Malicious Intent to direct frozen objects at them.**

## Kinetic Control

**With Kraft Work summoned, block just before a projectile reaches its front to freeze it. While blocking, use R just before a projectile hits to deflect and freeze it.**

**You can freeze 15 objects at once. They unfreeze when you dismiss Kraft Work or they leave your range. Punch frozen objects with M1 to charge them up to 6 times and change their direction. At full charge they fly three times as fast and deal up to 120% more impact damage. Use R to launch an object, or tap Werk to release everything. Shots that can bounce get one extra bounce.**

![suspend.gif](https://trello.com/1/cards/6ad7d76df72c581dfcbbcf35/attachments/6ae07b7643d2b7131623e506/previews/6ae07b8343d2b7131623f58f/download/suspend.gif)

## Lore:

## “DO YOU UNDERSTANDDDD!?”

**The stand of Rubber Soul, one of DIO’s assassins.. Yellow Temperance is a yellow, flesh-consuming substance that wraps around its user. It absorbs organic matter to grow and can imitate another person’s body and clothing, as Rubber Soul demonstrates by impersonating Kakyoin. Its soft body withstands powerful blows, heat and cold, but its protection cannot remove its user’s need to breathe.**

---

![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6abc324b5b8abd5060497d3b/attachments/6abc3d42d12b6c76d1cba08f/previews/6abc3d43d12b6c76d1cba13c/download/image.webp)

## Trapped Breath

**Living Armor holds 100 air and uses 5 each second. Hits cost another 1.25 air for each point of damage taken. With no air left you lose 12% of your max health each second. Hold Living Armor to open or close the mask; tap to remove the suit. Taking it off or opening the mask recovers 12 air per second. An open mask lowers body protection to 35% and leaves your head unprotected. Putting the suit back on does not refill it.**

## Assimilation

**Repeated hits and contact with slime build up to 10 stacks per enemy. Damage rises from 0.25 each second at one stack to 2.5 at ten, before bonuses and protection. Fresh slime adds stacks and refreshes the effect. Overlapping puddles still apply once per second.**

## **Feeding Slime**

**Your damage bonus counts your own Assimilation stacks across every enemy, Ten stacks on one enemy and five on another give you 15% more damage. When their slime wears off or is cleansed, you lose that part of the bonus. Dying or changing Stands clears it.**

## **Lore:**

**“GUGURGUURGURUGRUGUR”**

**The stand of Carne, one of the Boss’s bodyguards. Notorious B.I.G only awakens once its user is dead, driven by the hatred Carne died with. it hunts whatever moves fastest around it and eats anything it catches, growing larger the more it consumes. Because its user is already dead, there is nothing left of him that can be killed in the usual way.**

## Death Wish

**While Notorious B.I.G’s user is alive, every hit against them does 50% more damage.**

## Hate

**Landing hits, getting hurt, Stalking and insulting people  all build Hate, up to 250. It slowly fades when you haven’t added any for a few seconds. The more Hate you die with, the more Mass Notorious B.I.G rises with, and at full Hate it rises bigger.**

## Grudge

**Anyone who hurts you builds a Grudge against you, more the harder they hit, and whoever kills you gets a full one. It shows as a red bar over their head that only you can see. The dead Notorious B.I.G deals up to 50% more damage  to enemies with a Grudge. Grudges fade over time.**

## Hateful Punches

**Notorious B.I.G throws a slow barrage of hateful punches. Every hit builds Hate, and the last one staggers. Taking a hit interrupts it.**

**Base cooldown: 14s**

![hateful.gif](https://trello.com/1/cards/6ad640de1af12f56886658a5/attachments/6adfd7da313c0203da197c76/previews/6adfd7de313c0203da1980e8/download/hateful.gif)

## Insult

**Hiss and scream insults at everyone around you. Each enemy in range takes 20% more damage for 8 seconds, gives you Hate, and loses any Grudge they had against you.**

**Base cooldown: 14s**

![insult.gif](https://trello.com/1/cards/6ad640de1af12f56886658a5/attachments/6adfd831149f4b74483601a2/previews/6adfd833149f4b744836033f/download/insult.gif)

## Tumorous Pulse

**Notorious B.I.G steps out in front of you and smashes the ground, sending a wave of tumors bursting forward through it. Anyone it catches is thrown far forward and knocked down. Blocking it keeps you on your feet.**

**Base cooldown: 12s**

![pulse.gif](https://trello.com/1/cards/6ad640de1af12f56886658a5/attachments/6adfd881d9cab3fc0e89e53e/previews/6adfd884d9cab3fc0e89eb9a/download/pulse.gif)

## Stalk (HOLD)

**Hold to stare down an enemy in front of you. While they aren’t looking at you, or you’re too far away for them to notice, you build Hate. If anyone close by looks at you, you’re spotted and the stalk ends. It also ends once your Hate is full.**

**Base cooldown: 6s**

![STALK.gif](https://trello.com/1/cards/6ad640de1af12f56886658a5/attachments/6adfd900e24c145ecefb52c1/previews/6adfd904e24c145ecefb5621/download/STALK.gif)

---

## Good Luck (3 Bars)

**Costs 3 EX bars and all of your Hate. Your stand is put away and you burst into Notorious B.I.G on the spot, starting with 40 extra Mass. Works even while your next transformation is on cooldown.**

**Base cooldown: 30s**

![luck.gif](https://trello.com/1/cards/6ad640de1af12f56886658a5/attachments/6adfd99999af9ad31c263acd/previews/6adfd99d99af9ad31c2643e4/download/luck.gif)

## Vengeful Life

**the moment you would start Bleeding out, Notorious B.I.G emerges and you become it in the same life. Your health becomes Mass. It drains all the time and only eating brings it back, so you have to keep feeding. When your Mass runs out, you die for  real, and your next death within a minute is a normal one.**

## Blind

**As Notorious B.I.G you only see a short way through a dark fog. Past that, anyone walking shows up as a faint pink square, and anyone running or driving shows up as a bright one from much farther away, even through walls. While you’re eating or riding someone, you see through their eyes.**

![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6ad640de1af12f56886658a5/attachments/6adfda1aa0f2cf2cbdf770e1/previews/6adfda1aa0f2cf2cbdf7715b/download/image.webp)

## Can’t swim

**As Notorious B.I.G, deep water (the sea, lakes and pools, not puddles) kills you on the spot; the body sinks to the bottom and you respawn a few seconds later. Riding a boat is safe. While you’re still alive you swim like anyone else.**

![sink.gif](https://trello.com/1/cards/6ad640de1af12f56886658a5/attachments/6adfdadf81c6d51507d26e1f/previews/6adfdae581c6d51507d27414/download/sink.gif)

## Mouthful

**As Notorious B.I.G, picking up an object swallows it instead of carrying it. Attack or press the pick-up key again to spit it back out in front of you. It can’t throw things, and cars are too big to pick up.**

![swallow.gif](https://trello.com/1/cards/6ad640de1af12f56886658a5/attachments/6adfdb99278ee85ad9434d68/previews/6adfdb9d278ee85ad9435263/download/swallow.gif)

## Consumption

**Leap forward and latch onto the first enemy or loose object you reach. Enemies are eaten for a few seconds, giving you Mass with every bite. Objects are swallowed whole. Enemies with a Grudge against you take more damage.**

**Alternate form only, while summoned.**

**Base cooldown: 10s**

![consume.gif](https://trello.com/1/cards/6ad640de1af12f56886658a5/attachments/6adfdc6e4262b57abd0481ea/previews/6adfdc744262b57abd048725/download/consume.gif)

## Symbiosis

**When Consumption kills someone, Notorious B.I.G climbs inside their body and gets it back up. The body has a quarter of its old max health, and your hunger stops while you wear it. When the body gives out, you burst back out with the Mass you had before. Use Conceal to leave it early. Only an ordinary human body can be worn; animals like seals and cats, and story or boss characters, are just eaten.**

## Starving Tendrils

**Tendrils shoot at up to three of the closest things moving around you. Each hand that lands deals solid damage and grows over their arm, causing Weakness for 15 seconds. If one lands, use it again within 3 seconds to pull yourself to the nearest one hit. Reaches farther the bigger you are.**

**Base cooldown: 12s**

![tendril.gif](https://trello.com/1/cards/6ad640de1af12f56886658a5/attachments/6adfdd2ddd81ccd0063cd6ea/previews/6adfdd2edd81ccd0063cd86a/download/tendril.gif)

## Pull: (TAP AGAIN)

![pull.gif](https://trello.com/1/cards/6ad640de1af12f56886658a5/attachments/6adfddb09d035c3381ef117a/previews/6adfddb19d035c3381ef1661/download/pull.gif)

## Tendril

**Press Q to pull yourself forward with a tendril or attach onto a loose object or a person.**

![attach.gif](https://trello.com/1/cards/6ad640de1af12f56886658a5/attachments/6adfde51bb5e10b891768c49/previews/6adfde57bb5e10b89176926d/download/attach.gif)

## Conceal

**While riding someone’s back, seep into their clothes and vanish completely. Use it again to come out. A heavy attack on them knocks you out of them.**

**Base cooldown: 1.5s**

![conceal.gif](https://trello.com/1/cards/6ad640de1af12f56886658a5/attachments/6adfde9de5e764c73994af91/previews/6adfde9fe5e764c73994b312/download/conceal.gif)

## Flesh Dome

**EVASIVE; works while stunned, and can’t be hit out of when used that way. Tendrils burst out in every direction around you and above Notorious B.I.G, hurting everyone close by and throwing them away from you. Reaches farther the bigger you are.**

**Base cooldown: 12s**

## Ungraceful Aging

**Aging affects allies and enemies. Your neck and shoulders droop as stacks rise, and your attacks and dashes steadily weaken. Near 100 stacks, attack speed is reduced by up to 60% and dash power by up to 80%. At 100 stacks, players die immediately; PvE mobs cannot be killed by the stack cap. Each punch adds two stacks; Withering Mist adds two stacks every five seconds. After six seconds without more Aging, lose one stack every two seconds. Cleansing or death clears Aging.**

![m1sgratef.gif](https://trello.com/1/cards/6ab635789e86f9b20d8782e3/attachments/6ab63f32fd3e4fcfb6139e60/previews/6ab63f35fd3e4fcfb613a10a/download/m1sgratef.gif)

## Stand Mechanics:

## A Devil in Disguise/Automatic Stand

**Hold E while aiming at someone within 100 studs of the stand to follow them. It follows from behind and stops when watched. Yo-Yo Ma sends mosquitos after its chosen target, Acidic Saliva leaves them Muted.**

![2026-10-2712-29-29-ezgif.com-video-to-gif-converter.gif](https://trello.com/1/cards/6ad7e532cfa1f2b5ae82bc22/attachments/6ae09dd34c767d1f89e553ae/download/2026-10-2712-29-29-ezgif.com-video-to-gif-converter.gif)

## Repulsive

**Yo-Yo Ma takes no damage, but can be stunned or knocked away. Close hits splash saliva onto the attacker and makes them Stinky. Sending it flying splashes nearby enemies too.**

![2026-10-2712-30-38-ezgif.com-video-to-gif-converter.gif](https://trello.com/1/cards/6ad7e532cfa1f2b5ae82bc22/attachments/6ae09ef06b098d1db6700f81/download/2026-10-2712-30-38-ezgif.com-video-to-gif-converter.gif)

## Crybaby

**If the user is attacked while piloting the stand, they will cry out and be stunned for a few seconds.**

![2026-10-2712-24-31-ezgif.com-video-to-gif-converter.gif](https://trello.com/1/cards/6ad7e532cfa1f2b5ae82bc22/attachments/6ae09fe24a7846e40b45cc76/download/2026-10-2712-24-31-ezgif.com-video-to-gif-converter.gif)

## An Expert Craftsman

**Talk to Yo-Yo Ma while it is parked or following someone else. It can craft using your materials, heal 30 health, or shine your boots to grant Encouraged, giving 10% more damage for 40 seconds. Collect finished crafts within five seconds before someone else does. Your materials are only spent when the item is collected.**

![2026-10-2712-32-11-ezgif.com-video-to-gif-converter.gif](https://trello.com/1/cards/6ad7e532cfa1f2b5ae82bc22/attachments/6ae0a1042979b87119c744f9/download/2026-10-2712-32-11-ezgif.com-video-to-gif-converter.gif)

---

**Hold to cycle through items, then tap to make one in Yo-Yo Ma’s empty stomach. Use Treacherous Hoarder to spit it out. Real Mysterious Arrows and Rokakas take 60 to 30 minutes to make again. SSSS Rokakas and Over Heaven Arrows are fakes that deal delayed acid damage when used.**

## Stone Deity

**Use E to release Rolling Stones. It follows its own targets and cannot be recalled.**

![summon.gif](https://trello.com/1/cards/6ab58f3d81b8eb127e57c627/attachments/6ab656288cab13f835806051/previews/6ab656298cab13f835806235/download/summon.gif)

## Spiritual Connection

**use Ctrl to watch from the stone. This only changes your view. If you die, the stone remains, removes its current target, and moves to the next.**

## We Are All Slaves Of Fate

**Eight seconds after summon, a random player or NPC becomes Roling Stone’s target and receives a hidden timer of 120 seconds. The user cannot be the first target, Rolling and leaping begin after the first 10% of the timer; until then the stone can still melt and reappear near its target. Its rolling speed rises as that person’s timer runs down. If the target evades touching the stand for the entire timer, the stone then chooses someone else. Rolling Stones leaps over obstacles or melts and reappears when it cannot clear the route.**

## Ruthlessness Is Mercy

**If the stone touches its current target, that target dies immediately and painlessly. Contact with anyone else is harmless.**

![kill.gif](https://trello.com/1/cards/6ab58f3d81b8eb127e57c627/attachments/6ab65ac30d86eef350cd7327/previews/6ab65ac60d86eef350cd759f/download/kill.gif)

## It’s Not My Time Yet

**While someone else is the stone’s current target, damage to someone holding the stone is absorbed by the stone instead. Carrying the stone prevents the holder from attacking or healing, and moving too far away from the stone’s target will cause it to melt through their hands to escape.**

**The stone rolls after its target and leaps when close.**

**The stone changes form as it loses health.**

## Lore:

## **“Lali-ho!”**

**The Stand of Mannish Boy, an eleven month-old baby hired to kill the Joestar group. Death 13 rules the world of dreams, where its masked, scythe-wielding form can do anything it likes to whoever falls asleep. It’s user sleeping body is the one thing it leaves vulnerable in the waking world.**

---

![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6ac8f4b3f915753c2ebe8468/attachments/6ae08aca33d9c17c59511ce0/previews/6ae08acb33d9c17c59511e33/download/image.webp)

## Pose:

![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6ac8f4b3f915753c2ebe8468/attachments/6ae08ad8482efeef8c2073e9/previews/6ae08ad9482efeef8c2074e1/download/image.webp)

---

## Drowsiness

**Your light and heavy attacks and certain skills add Drowsiness. At 3 stacks, enemies become Tired. At 10, they can see Death 13 and be hurt by its attacks. At 30, they fall into Slumber. Stacks decay after 12 seconds without another hit.**

![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6ac8f4b3f915753c2ebe8468/attachments/6ae08b2c6007d50121156325/previews/6ae08b2d6007d501211563ed/download/image.webp)

## Slumber

**Slumber lasts 6 seconds, up to 12 with more Ability. Taking damage shortens it by 1 second. Damage over 4 wakes sleeping targets instantly. After waking, the target resists Drowsiness and Slumber for 3 seconds.**

![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6ac8f4b3f915753c2ebe8468/attachments/6ae08b6b25a5766e938802ae/previews/6ae08b6c25a5766e9388032a/download/image.webp)

## Sleeping Powder

**Blow out a cloud of sleeping powder that grows in size and slowly drifts forward. Anyone inside is briefly stunned, has their vision blurred, and gains 5 Drowsiness for every second they stay in it. it does no damage.**

**Base cooldown: 14s**

![powder.gif](https://trello.com/1/cards/6ac8f4b3f915753c2ebe8468/attachments/6ae08be0c710475daa572d5d/previews/6ae08be5c710475daa5734b3/download/powder.gif)

## Sleepwalk

**Recover health while sleepwalking for 10 seconds. Hits during the first 2 seconds trigger a scythe counter that raises the attacker to 10 Drowsiness, or adds 5 if they already have 10 or more. Later hits wake you. Use again to wake early.**

**Base cooldown: 28s**

![sleep.gif](https://trello.com/1/cards/6ac8f4b3f915753c2ebe8468/attachments/6ae08c7822a215dfb30ddde2/previews/6ae08c7e22a215dfb30df4bd/download/sleep.gif)

## Counter:

![counter13.gif](https://trello.com/1/cards/6ac8f4b3f915753c2ebe8468/attachments/6ae08cad26c843dee2f368c9/previews/6ae08cb026c843dee2f369c3/download/counter13.gif)

## Pan Smack

**Whack the nearest enemy over the head with a frying pan. It knocks them forward and down and adds 5 Drowsiness. Small props in the swing go flying.**

**Base cooldown: 14s**

![smack.gif](https://trello.com/1/cards/6ac8f4b3f915753c2ebe8468/attachments/6ae08d28a28dcc3349d55789/previews/6ae08d29a28dcc3349d55b21/download/smack.gif)

## Nightmare

**Kneel and touch a sleeping enemy to take them into a dream for 30 seconds, where Death 13 fights them on its own. Use it beside any other sleeper to bring them into the same dream, or use it again to wake everyone. use Pilot to take control of Death 13, and again to return to your body at any time.**

**Base cooldown: 40s**

![kneel.gif](https://trello.com/1/cards/6ac8f4b3f915753c2ebe8468/attachments/6ae08fec4f65b3c0c974fed3/previews/6ae08fef4f65b3c0c975009b/download/kneel.gif)

## Taking control of Death 13: (LCtrl)

![pilot.gif](https://trello.com/1/cards/6ac8f4b3f915753c2ebe8468/attachments/6ae0900e8fee00fca557d37d/previews/6ae090138fee00fca557d7e9/download/pilot.gif)

‌

## Lali Ho

**Kneel and touch a sleeping enemy with Nightmare to take them into a dream for 30 seconds. Use Nightmare beside any other sleeper to  bring them into the same dream. Nightmare can be reused to wake everyone. Death 13 automatically fights targets inside the nightmare on its own. You are able to personally take control with Ctrl; use Ctrl again to return to your body at any time. Your body can be hurt but the sleeping targets cannot. While Death 13 is in the dream realm, Grim Carousel, Boomerang and Vanishing Reap can’t be used outside, and your body fights with its own fists. Your other moves still work. If the dreamers deal enough damage to Death 13, the dream shatters and everyone wakes. Dreamers keep their first two Stand moves only if their Stand was summoned before sleep.**

![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6ac8f4b3f915753c2ebe8468/attachments/6ae09018567d8213fd81f4e0/previews/6ae09019567d8213fd81f5a3/download/image.webp)

**Three random pieces of furniture rise around Death 13, hang high for a moment, then fly at a target. Each one that lands stuns briefly, and the last one sends them flying. They can be blocked or broken.**

**Base cooldown: 18s**

![furniture.gif](https://trello.com/1/cards/6ac8f4b3f915753c2ebe8468/attachments/6ae090cc974a12b47587d243/previews/6ae090ce974a12b47587d6d8/download/furniture.gif)

## Scary Box

**Drop a cage where you aim, trapping the dreamer for 5 seconds. Death 13 can pass through the bars.**

**Base cooldown: 20s**

**Death 13 vanishes, appears infront of the opponent and slashes with its scythe.**

## Sweeper

## Lore:

## “I’ll be the judge!”

**The Stand of Jotaro Kujo, now known as Star Platinum: The World. It  retains Star Platinum’s strength,speed, and precision, along with the ability to stop time that Jotaro discovered during his fight with DIO**.

---

‌

## Platinum Parry

**With your stand summoned, hold F. Press m1 to try to catch a projectile or R to deflect it.**

## M1

![m1.gif](https://trello.com/1/cards/6acd35b51579458f6d83dcf1/attachments/6ace77f60bdb006f9a5639f0/previews/6ace77f80bdb006f9a563e9b/download/m1.gif)

## Moveset:

## Ora Blitz

**Send Star Platinum forward in a barrage that carries enemies along.**

**Deflects incoming projectiles. You can punch and use sub-ability skills during the rush, or use it while piloting.**

**Base cooldown: 19s**

![blitz.gif](https://trello.com/1/cards/6acd35b51579458f6d83dcf1/attachments/6acd397e703ba7b8e8f850ec/previews/6acd3982703ba7b8e8f85ae1/download/blitz.gif)

**Flick a steel bearing that stuns and knocks enemies back. Headshots knock them down and blur their vision.**

**Reaches up to 250 studs. Can be blocked and used while piloting.**

**Base cooldown: 9s**

![bodyshoot.gif](https://trello.com/1/cards/6acd35b51579458f6d83dcf1/attachments/6acd38c12d657b85f53a70ad/previews/6acd38c42d657b85f53a78b4/download/bodyshoot.gif)

**Counter an attack by appearing behind the attacker, then throw a heavy punch that knocks them down. They can turn and block it.**

**Base cooldown: 24s**

![counter.gif](https://trello.com/1/cards/6acd35b51579458f6d83dcf1/attachments/6ace75669ea50466584e5c10/previews/6ace75689ea50466584e5d33/download/counter.gif)

**Jump up to 64 studs at base Ability, with more Ability extending the distance. Keeps your momentum and briefly breaks NPC targeting. Works with your Stand summoned or dismissed.**

## EX: [Awakening Moveset]

## Campfire

**Build a campfire in front of your Stand. Interact to sit and recover health, even during combat. Its warmth dries you off, but stepping into the flames burns and briefly stuns you.**

**Build on flat ground in front of your Stand. Including while piloting. Interact to rest and recover 3 health each second, even in combat. Interact again or jump to get up. Taking damage ends your rest. Its warmth dries you off and makes aging worse.**

**The fire lasts 10 seconds. Anyone touching the flames takes damage, briefly stumbles, and catches fire, including you. Attacks, liquid moves, and uncovered rain can put it out. During Time Stop, it waits to ignite until time resumes. Costs no EX.**

**Base cooldown: 20s**

![campfire.gif](https://trello.com/1/cards/6acd35b51579458f6d83dcf1/attachments/6acd3b2b4f4c39d9a21539c9/previews/6acd3b2f4f4c39d9a2154613/download/campfire.gif)

**Star Platinum rushes an enemy from the front, barrages them, then slams them into the ground. You can move and attack once it sets off.**

**Tap for a short Time Stop, or hold for the full duration. Both reach 150 studs. Use it during another player’s Time Stop to move again.**

**Tap for an instant stop, even with your Stand dismissed, for 1 EX bar. With your Stand summoned, hold to spend 4 on a longer stop with windup. A short stop has a 20s cooldown; a full stop has a 60s cooldown. Using it during someone else’s Time Stop lets you move; a large enough Ability advantage lets yours take over.**

**ABILITY SCALING: At 1 Ability, a tap lasts 2 seconds and a hold lasts 3.5 seconds. At 100 Ability, both last twice as long.**

# **“Channel Hamon through close-range attacks and objects you throw.”**

---

![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6ab432a16505cfdb76c223bf/attachments/6abbaa729a645280ff71331c/previews/6abbaa739a645280ff71336d/download/image.webp)

## Infused Throwables

**Pick up an object with your character to infuse it with Hamon. Infused heavy objects and spears release a Hamon ripple when they land. Gasoline carries Hamon into its puddle. Picking an object up through your Stand does not apply this infusion.**

![hamonthr.gif](https://trello.com/1/cards/6ab432a16505cfdb76c223bf/attachments/6ab5896f2d54b7c27399493b/previews/6ab589732d54b7c2739949e0/download/hamonthr.gif)

## Sunlight Yellow Overdrive

**After a short windup, strike repeatedly in front of you. You move slowly  and cannot jump during the attack. The barrage wears down a blocking target’s posture and grants armor while the punches are active.**

**Base cooldown: 23s**

![yellowoverdrive.gif](https://trello.com/1/cards/6ab432a16505cfdb76c223bf/attachments/6ab587e3f47fc6b7249ff78b/previews/6ab587e7f47fc6b7249ffbfb/download/yellowoverdrive.gif)

## Scarlet Overdrive

**Wind up a close-range uppercut. An unblocked hit ignites the target and sends them upward and forward. Blocking takes posture damage, and the attack can be parried. It can also ignite nearby gasoline.**

**Base cooldown: 18s**

![scarlet2.gif](https://trello.com/1/cards/6ab432a16505cfdb76c223bf/attachments/6ab588e1891c6550642ff7f5/previews/6ab588e4891c6550642ffba4/download/scarlet2.gif)

## Zoom Punch

**Strike the nearest enemy in front of you within reach, briefly stunning them and knocking them back. The punch can be blocked or parried and cannot reach through walls. Throwing it costs 2 health, but cannot reduce you below 1 health.**

**Base cooldown: 12s**

**While Hamonic lasts, you recover health, dash farther and infuse light attacks with Hamon, A fuller bar gives stronger healing and dashes. Breathe again to top it up. At full charge, the bar waits three seconds before draining. Taking a hit stops your breath, but keeps the Hamonic you already built. Effects that prevent healing still apply.**

**Base cooldown: 1s**

**Release a burst of Hamon, even while stunned. Repeated hits build Ripple, then the final hit knocks enemies away. The burst also deflects thrown objects. It starts twice as fast when you aren't stunned.**

## Lore:

# **“This is the last of my Hamon!”**

**Ceasar Zeppeli channels hamon through bubbles made with his gloves. Even at death's door, he can leave his remaining Hamon to a friend.**

## Pose:

## This is the last of my Hamon!

**Complete the four prompts while knocked to give up your life and leave a blood bubble. A copy of your accessories floats inside.**

**Touch it within 30 seconds to collect it. It heals them for 10 seconds and adds Ripple to their punches. Hamon users also get full breath. Vampires die if they take it.**

## Moveset:

## Bubble Launcher

**Fire eight bubbles toward your aim. Hits briefly stun and apply Ripple. The bubbles also push loose objects away.**

**Base cooldown: 9s**

![launch.gif](https://trello.com/1/cards/6aca84ba1ea3235927b014ce/attachments/6aca9de9f93566119a8210f0/previews/6aca9debf93566119a821248/download/launch.gif)

## Bubble Cutter

**Throw two cutters one after another in a small spread. They skim over the floor, briefly stun and cause bleeding for 4 seconds.**

**Base cooldown: 11s**

![cutter.gif](https://trello.com/1/cards/6aca84ba1ea3235927b014ce/attachments/6aca9e5f889c7e4372ac14ec/previews/6aca9e61889c7e4372ac160b/download/cutter.gif)

## The next moves are exclusive to non-stand users.

## Seated Jump [EVASIVE] [1 Bar]

**Spring away in a seated leap.**

**Aim where you want to jump. Use it while stunned to break free.**

![steated.gif](https://trello.com/1/cards/6aca84ba1ea3235927b014ce/attachments/6acaa4f9d5df11df12ced108/previews/6acaa4fbd5df11df12ced249/download/steated.gif)

**After the grab, they walk toward your cursor for 3 seconds. Another hit freezes them. They stop at walls and ledges.**

**Base cooldown: 16s**

![hypnosis.gif](https://trello.com/1/cards/6aca84ba1ea3235927b014ce/attachments/6aca9efdcb42f1f7f78ca0a2/previews/6aca9f01cb42f1f7f78ca37d/download/hypnosis.gif)

## **Bubble Lenses / Breathe [HOLD]**

**Place up to three lenses that fire burning beams at nearby enemies. They last 25 seconds, and placing a fourth replaces the oldest. Sunlight makes their beams stronger. Hit a lens with Hamon to send beams between nearby lenses. Enemies can break them.**

**Base cooldown: 1s**

![LENS.gif](https://trello.com/1/cards/6aca84ba1ea3235927b014ce/attachments/6aca9fbb58bcf9fc3cb7926b/previews/6aca9fc558bcf9fc3cb799ac/download/LENS.gif)

## Breathe **[HOLD]**

**Hold to build your breath. While charged, you heal, dash further and add Ripple to your punches. Taking a hit stops your breathing but keeps the charge you built. Breathing has its own cooldown.**

![breathe.gif](https://trello.com/1/cards/6aca84ba1ea3235927b014ce/attachments/6acaa06bc57621dcfc42f3a4/previews/6acaa06fc57621dcfc42f7e0/download/breathe.gif)

**The bubble lifts an enemy for 3 seconds and hurts them with Hamon. Another hit pops it, so teammates can break them free. It can also hold loose throwables.**

**Base cooldown: 22s**

![barrier.gif](https://trello.com/1/cards/6aca84ba1ea3235927b014ce/attachments/6acaa228743f1ba57520bd61/previews/6acaa22a743f1ba57520bfb3/download/barrier.gif)

# Lore:

# **“An undead body sustained by blood. Keep fed and stay out of the sun.”**

---

## Pose:

![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6ab432a271c7f0cb67b73072/attachments/6aca975056a2e93cdf13aa0e/previews/6aca975156a2e93cdf13ab6b/download/image.webp)

![image\_2026-10-04\_162137465.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6ab432a271c7f0cb67b73072/attachments/6ac260f1b130c154197abc1d/previews/6ac260f2b130c154197abd32/download/image_2026-10-04_162137465.webp)

---

## Blood (Sustain)

**Your blood reserve appears above the skill list. Combat refills it and recovery spends it. Regenerate 20% faster with blood, or 20% slower without it. In PvP, recovery needs blood. Healing restrictions still apply.**

![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6ab432a271c7f0cb67b73072/attachments/6ac261ed7c2f5d4fa9674a71/previews/6ac261ed7c2f5d4fa9674afb/download/image.webp)

## Sunlight (Weakness)

**Direct sunlight burns you after half a second. Full shade lets the exposure fade. Substantial opaque cover can protect you; glass and ordinary lights do not change sunlight exposure. The Sun’s active heat zone can also expose you.**

## Ripple (Weakness)

**Hamon attacks apply Ripple for 3 seconds. Repeated hits build it up to a cap. Ripple burns vampires more strongly and stops passive regeneration until it fades or is cleansed.**

## Undead Body (Passive)

**Eating Rokaka removes your Vampire sub ability and applies its stone exchange. Vampires can also eat apples to remove their Stand and use their full Vampire moveset, but cannot eat other food or use healing consumables. Ordinary healing restores only a quarter as much health. Vampire stays active alongside your Stand. Your dash lasts 40% longer, briefly hides your body and leaves dark-red afterimages behind you. (You also get red eyes during the night)**

---

# Moveset:

## Blood Drain

**Rush forward and grab an enemy. Drain their blood to refill your blood meter and heal, then throw them to your left. You can turn while feeding.**

**Base cooldown: 18s**

## **Overview:**

**Within the Train Raid, you act as a rogue member of the gang Passione, travelling from cart to cart defeating enemies and uncovering clues.**

![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6ad48b64681a5cb2b4e02ae3/attachments/6ae3bf700ddbcd6037103493/previews/6ae3bf710ddbcd603710349c/download/image.webp)

---

## **CART VARIATIONS:**

### **THESE RANDOMISE PER RAID.**

### **VARIANTS:**

**Help the ‘Old Lady’ find a certain belonging, this can be the following: Lemonade & her scarf. After returning the item to her, you must locate the pin in her purse to picklock the door to the next Cart.**

**Protect Coco jumbo for 140 seconds.**

**Clear 2 waves of enemies, some stand users, some not. - 5 NPC's per wave. (Depending on your party size)**

**Obtain an ice-pack to prevent yourself from aging, and then hide Coco Jumbo under a seat. Once this is complete you must protect the civilians from aging and/or dying from Prosciutto by giving them ice packs. (Protect them for 1:45)**

**Find the conductors key to open the next car. (Must dodge Pesci's line by unequipping your stand and crouching behind couches)**

**Find the conductors key to open the next car. (No threat)**

**Kill Prosciutto. (CART LOCKED, NOT RANDOMISED)**

**Fight 3 Passione members on the roof of the cart (The boss can have any pinnacle stand) while the others have a randomised, non pinnacle stand. After defeating them all you must break the roof of the cart to re-enter. (Obstacle's will appear and you have to dodge them)**

**The 3 hints quest. You must find 3 hints (This includes items on the ground.) then you must question the passengers (They will say stuff like "I don't wanna see you." or "I travel alone." After prompting they will reveal themselves as Passione members, you must kill them and then you can enter the next cart.**
